FROM ENQUIRY TO A CLEARER SCOPE

Ask the useful questions first.

01

Product & inclusions

Confirm model, capacity, accessories and what the quoted unit includes. One panel is not automatically a complete sized pool-heating installation.

02

Delivery & installation

Provide your delivery area and site needs. Confirm the receiving route, packed dimensions, installation scope and correct manufacturer manual with the quotation.

03

Support & documentation

Request the applicable warranty, service route and installation requirements for your exact model. No universal warranty or guaranteed savings figure is assumed.

Are2,3 or6 units a pack?

No. They are example order quantities. Every product is sold individually. No quantity discount or compulsory bundle is stated here.

Does the enquiry button send an order?

No. It opens an email or WhatsApp draft on your device. You review and send it yourself. This page has no server submission, payment or stock-reservation function.

Can a trade buyer get separate pricing?

Yes—request a written unit quotation with your product, quantity and receiving location. Confidential trade prices are not embedded in this public landing page.
